name: Zoho Vault
summary: Zoho Vault starts at $0.90 per user a month on annual billing, and monthly billing is offered on every paid plan. Single sign-on through SAML, directory sync and SIEM integrations are on the Enterprise plan at $7.20 per user a month.

facts.text: Encryption and decryption happen in the browser with AES-256, and Zoho Vault never stores the master password.
Zoho Vault is listed in the scope of Zoho's SOC 2 plus HIPAA Type 2 report, and Zoho acts as a Business Associate for covered products.
The free plan does not allow password sharing or inviting users, so teams need a paid plan.
The 15-day trial covers the Enterprise plan for up to five users, and an account that does not upgrade moves to the free plan with its data kept.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Billed annually; $5 billed monthly. Minimum 5 users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually; $8 billed monthly. Minimum 5 users.

hiddenCosts: SAML single sign-on, Active Directory and Entra ID login, Okta and OneLogin integration, and SIEM integration are on the Enterprise plan only.
Professional and Enterprise require at least 5 users.

contract.cancellation: To stop a renewal, notify Zoho at least seven days before the renewal date.
contract.dataExport: Plain-text export of passwords, or an encrypted HTML copy that opens only with the master password.
